import json
import re
import sys

path = "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-105/template/.rulesync/permissions.jsonc"
text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
# Strip // line comments and /* */ block comments (none expected; JSONC form).
stripped = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", text, flags=re.S)
stripped = re.sub(r"(?m)^\s*//.*$", "", stripped)
data = json.loads(stripped)
rules = []
for tool, table in data["permission"].items():
    for pattern, action in table.items():
        rules.append((tool, pattern, action))
print(rules)
expected = [("edit", ".tickets/**", "deny"), ("bash", "sudo *", "deny")]
sys.exit(0 if rules == expected else 1)
